These Zords gain the benefit of the following bonuses: •. The Zord has a default Smarts and Social of 2 when no crew is currently driving • The Zord’s Driving (Autopilot) Skill gains 1

Engaging Dino Drive Mode requires a Standard action, imposing a −3 penalty (minimum 1) to the Speed Essence of their Zord until the start of its next turn. ba666a09a339.d: Needs Auxiliary Zord Feature, Combiner Zord Feature When confronting the evils of the universe, Zords combine to create Megaforms whose power and toughness are far greater than any individual Zord. However, sometimes these Megaforms are not enough to defeat the overwhelming power of evil. In these dire situations, Megaforms can unleash devastatingly powerful attacks to save the day! However, these displays of overwhelming force can only be utilized sparingly due to the immense energy and coordination required. Once per scene, a Megaform that includes at least one Zord with this Feature can initiate a Signature Finishing Move as a Standard action. This is either a Melee Weapon Attack (Might) or Ranged Weapon Attack (Targeting) that deals 4× the damage of the participant attack of the same type. The type of attack and the type of damage that it deals is chosen at the selection of this Feature.
